name: In Service of Zephras
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The High Order has done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there's rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
narrative.objectives: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
narrative.offerRewardText: I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 10 to 12, 3,765 XP in all.

quests.name: The Missing Scholar
quests.objectiveText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Dondallion Whisperwind in Valanaar.

quests.name: Fillion's Mission
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.

quests.name: Catching Wind
quests.objectiveText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it once there.

quests.name: Avenged Tenfold
quests.objectiveText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

quests.name: In Service of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
